The Standards Stack

The codes that govern every Indonesian engagement.

Indonesia practice runs the SNI and PUIL stack. International standards overlay for multinational client deliverables. Bahasa Indonesia deliverable extracts standard.

Indonesian Standard
SNI Series
Standar Nasional Indonesia. The federal standards body family. SNI cross-references on every electrical and safety deliverable.
Wiring Rules
PUIL 2011
Persyaratan Umum Instalasi Listrik. The Indonesian general electrical installation standard. Statutory baseline.
International
IEC 60909 + IEC 60079
IEC short-circuit and Ex-rated installation standards. Pertamina and Cilegon engineering baseline.
Oil & Gas Safety
K3 Migas
Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja Migas. Indonesian oil and gas worker safety regulation. Mandatory across upstream and downstream engagements.
International Overlay
NFPA 70E + IEEE 1584
Applied for multinational client deliverables and US-aligned Indonesian subsidiaries.
Sign-Off
Insinyur Profesional / CEng MIE
Indonesian PII (Persatuan Insinyur Indonesia) Insinyur Profesional accreditation plus CEng MIE.

Five Deliverables

Five disciplines. Five Indonesian deliverables.

The five brownfield digital engineering practices applied across Pertamina downstream, Cilegon petchem, Java power, and Kalimantan-Sulawesi mining operations.

Discipline 01
Power System Studies
Load flow, short circuit, protection coordination, arc flash per PUIL 2011 + IEC 60909 + IEEE 1584. SNI cross-references applied.
Discipline 02
3D LiDAR Scanning
Leica RTC 360 brownfield asset capture across Cilegon petrochem, Java thermal plants, and Sulawesi nickel processing.
Discipline 03
As-Built Engineering
P&ID, SLDs, isometric drawings per PUIL and SNI conventions. K3 Migas-aligned documentation standards.
Discipline 04
Discrete Event Simulation
FlexSim. Throughput across Indonesian ports, mining conveyor systems, and Cilegon petrochem process flows.
Discipline 05
Risk + Safety + AMC
HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, SIL per IEC 61511. K3 Migas oil and gas worker safety compliance. 5-year arc flash recertification AMC retainer.

Statutory Authorities

The Indonesian authorities we answer to.

Every Indonesian engagement runs through at least one of these statutory authorities.

ESDM
Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
Indonesian energy ministry. Engaged for grid interconnection, oil and gas licensing, and mining regulatory oversight.
BPN
National Land Agency
Site tenure and land use compliance for industrial estate engagements.
K3 Migas
K3 Migas Authority
Oil and gas worker safety regulator. Mandatory compliance across upstream and downstream.
BSN
National Standardization Agency
Custodian of SNI standards family. Cross-referenced across deliverables.
KLHK
Ministry of Environment and Forestry
Environmental compliance overlay on chemical, refining, mining, and heavy industry sites.
PII
Persatuan Insinyur Indonesia
Indonesian engineer licensing authority. Insinyur Profesional accreditation framework for regulated deliverables.
Three Indonesia Projects

Three Indonesian brownfield projects. Landmark by NDA.

Identifying details withheld. Engineering substance disclosed. Each carries a named Chartered Engineer signature on the final deliverable.

Case 01 · LiDAR + As-Built
Major Tier-1 refiner · Sumatra
3D LiDAR scan of legacy process units. 2,900 m of P&ID regenerated. Single-line diagrams refreshed across 30/11/0.4 kV. PUIL conventions applied. Native handover for the digital twin pilot. Insinyur Profesional signature.
LiDAR + As-Built · PUIL + SNI
Case 02 · Power System Study
Major Indonesian petchem · Cilegon
Power system study refresh on the 150/11 kV intake. Short-circuit recalculation per IEC 60909. Protection coordination across the 11 kV ring main. Arc flash assessment.
PSS · IEC 60909 + IEEE 1584
Case 03 · Risk + Safety + AMC
Major Indonesian nickel operator · Sulawesi
HAZOP refresh on the HPAL module. SIL assessment per IEC 61511 on the SIS. LOPA on the acid leach reactor. 5-year arc flash AMC retainer locked.
HAZOP + SIL + AMC · IEC 61511

Common Questions

Common questions about Indonesia operations.

How is the VB Engineering Indonesia entity structured?
Jakarta-registered operations entity. Engineers hold Insinyur Profesional accreditation under PII plus CEng MIE. K3 Migas registration maintained for upstream and downstream work.
Which Indonesian and international standards do you engineer to?
SNI family + PUIL 2011 primary. IEC 60909 + IEC 60079. K3 Migas regulations on oil and gas. NFPA 70E + IEEE 1584 for multinational deliverables.
Do you produce Bahasa Indonesia bilingual safety signage?
Yes. Mandatory under K3 Migas regulations. Standard practice on Pertamina downstream, Cilegon petrochem, and Kalimantan mining.
Which industries do you cover in Indonesia?
Oil and Gas (Pertamina), Petrochemicals (Cilegon), Power (Java thermal, geothermal), Mining (Kalimantan coal, Sulawesi nickel), Pharmaceutical, Heavy Manufacturing.
How fast do you respond to an Indonesian scoping request?
Within 24 hours a named Insinyur Profesional or CEng MIE is on the line. Joint scoping document within 72 hours. Full proposal in IDR or USD within 7 calendar days.
What is the relationship with VB Group and Wistwin?
VB Engineering Indonesia is the field practice. Wistwin is the sister platform that converts engineering output into a digital twin SaaS subscription. Every Indonesia engagement is structured for native handover to Wistwin.
